plugins.name: askairank
plugins.description: See how ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and other AI engines mention your brand: visibility per engine, the answers that named you, competitors and cited sources. Connects to your AskAiRank account.

skills.name: competitor-check
skills.description: Find which competitors AI engines recommend for a brand's market and compare the brand with one of them engine by engine, using AskAiRank data. Use when the user asks who ChatGPT or Perplexity recommends instead of them, or how they stack up against a named competitor.
skills.description_zh: 通过 AskAiRank 查找 AI 引擎在品牌市场中推荐的竞品，并逐引擎比较指定竞品与本品牌。

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Connect Claude to an AskAiRank account and confirm the connection works. Use when the user installs the AskAiRank plugin, asks how to sign in, or an AskAiRank tool fails with an authentication error.
skills.description_zh: 连接 Claude 与 AskAiRank 账号并验证可用性，适用于首次安装、登录和工具认证失败。

skills.name: track-prompt
skills.description: Add a new buyer question for AskAiRank to track and optionally check it right away across AI engines. Use when the user wants to monitor a new query, keyword or question in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or Gemini answers.
skills.description_zh: 向 AskAiRank 添加待跟踪的买家问题、关键词或查询，可立即跨 ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity、Gemini 检查回答。

skills.name: visibility-report
skills.description: Build a short AI visibility report for a brand tracked in AskAiRank: visibility per engine, trend, the answers that mentioned the brand and the sources those engines cited. Use when the user asks how visible their brand is in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or Gemini, or wants a weekly or monthly AI search summary.
skills.description_zh: 为 AskAiRank 跟踪的品牌生成简短 AI 搜索可见度报告，包含逐引擎表现、趋势、提及品牌的回答与引用来源，适用于周/月回顾。

headings: AskAiRank plugin for Claude Code and Cowork
